Born at Stundwiller in the Bas-Rhin on 17 August 1786, son of Jacques Staebell and Catherine Casper,
and spent his whole life there. He married Marie Anne Casper in 1809.
In the census of 1846 he was sixty and the village’s garde champêtre, the warden who watched the fields and crops,
living in house 60 on the Dorfgasse with four of his children: Madelaine, 25, Catherine,
20, François, 17, and Barbe, 13. François, called Frank, left for America in 1853,
and Barbe followed him to Iowa. He died at Stundwiller in 1873.
Born at Stundwiller, Bas-Rhin, about 1788, daughter of Antoine Casper and Marie Anne Fischer.
She married François Staebell there on 23 December 1809.
Of their children, Frank, born in 1828, left for America in 1853, and his sister Barbe followed him to Iowa.
She died at Stundwiller on 4 January 1860.
